2.5 FA-1 relight-pulse load

The fuel-assisted relight pulse (FMEA FA-1) is published as an envelope over the Combustion v2.4a case grid, computed on a vented three-node construct with ASSUMED inputs: an estimate, not acceptance evidence. The lead set the structural load on it (CHANGELOG 173). The single point in combustion.json v2.4 is not a load any more and is annotated wherever it is quoted (OVR-07).

8.2 Fields

8.3 Afterburning and model limits

ItemReport statement
Afterburning at the v1 pointadds 172-182 K at O/F 7.76 (temporal band 172-178 K; time-matched fine maximum 179.2 K; Richardson extrapolation of the three levels 181.8 K); SIMT1039
Afterburning at the v2 pointadds nothing at the v2 point for an equilibrium exhaust (O/F 10.4, oxidiser-rich; 0.44 K). The stream-B upper bound, which releases the c* deficit by fast chemistry, raises the plume maximum from 2705 K to 3011 K at that point (difference of maxima, +306 K; ownruns/c_2s_100_v2op/fig/c2s_v2op_afterburn_stats.json); SIMT1040
Afterburning at the stretch flooradds up to 1476 K at the fuel-rich 12.5 % floor. SIMT1041
Limit: Soot and radiationSoot and radiation. There is no soot model and no radiative transfer. The synthetic photo uses an ASSUMED soot proxy. SIMT1042
Limit: Finite-rate chemistryFinite-rate chemistry and turbulence-chemistry interaction. Afterburning is a fast-chemistry, mean-Z equilibrium bound. Real afterburning is lower, and possibly zero if the mixture quenches. SIMT1043
Limit: Exhaust gas modelExhaust gas model. The exhaust is a calorically perfect gas with frozen calibrated gamma, which gives core temperature errors up to about -500/+30 K in the strongly expanded region (§4). SIMT1044
Limit: Geometry and settingGeometry and setting. The model is axisymmetric only (no gimbal angle, no 3-D structure) and has no ground plane, so no landing impingement or recirculation is modelled. SIMT1045
Limit: DurationDuration. Simulated time is 3-4 ms. The far field (> 15 De) is not statistically stationary, and the fine level covers only 0.25 ms. SIMT1046
Limit: No acousticsNo acoustics or plume loads on the vehicle. SIMT1047
